topic: Belimumab and anifrolumab in SLE: mechanism, indications, trial data

source.title: Indirect comparative efficacy and safety of belimumab vs. anifrolumab in systemic lupus erythematosus and lupus nephritis
source.whyItFits: Stored abstract of an indirect comparison of the two biologics, including indication differences, SRI-4, steroid taper, herpes zoster, and lupus nephritis uncertainty. Molecular mechanism is not described in the abstract, so it is not questioned.

notes: TULIP-2 full text is not open. Mechanism (BAFF versus IFNAR) is not in the stored abstract and was not added.
